arabic text: PYAARI NABI KI, PYAARI NAWAASI\nSHAAM KO QAIDI BAN KE CHALI HAI
english translation text: THE BELOVED OF THE PROPHET (SAW), HIS CHERISHED GRANDDAUGHTER\nLEAVES FOR SHAAM AS A PRISONER

arabic text: SABR KI MALKA, ZEHRA KI PYAARI\nSHAAM KO QAIDI BAN KE CHALI HAI
english translation text: THE QUEEN OF PATIENCE, THE BELOVED OF ZEHRA (AS)\nLEAVES FOR SHAAM AS A PRISONER

arabic text: PYAARI NABI KI, PYAARI NAWAASI\nSHAAM KO QAIDI BAN KE CHALI HAI
english translation text: THE BELOVED OF THE PROPHET (SAW), HIS CHERISHED GRANDDAUGHTER\nLEAVES FOR SHAAM AS A PRISONER

arabic text: DEKH RAHI HAI KOI TO AAYE, SHAANA PAKAR KAR KAASH BITHAAYE\nNA HAI SAWAARI NA HAI AMAARI, SHAAM KO QAIDI BAN KE CHALI HAI
english translation text: SHE LOOKS ON — WOULD THAT SOMEONE MIGHT COME, TAKE HER BY THE SHOULDER AND SEAT HER\nNO MOUNT, NO CANOPIED LITTER — SHE LEAVES FOR SHAAM AS A PRISONER

arabic text: PYAARI NABI KI, PYAARI NAWAASI\nSHAAM KO QAIDI BAN KE CHALI HAI
english translation text: THE BELOVED OF THE PROPHET (SAW), HIS CHERISHED GRANDDAUGHTER\nLEAVES FOR SHAAM AS A PRISONER

arabic text: BHAAI BHATEEJE BHAANJE BETE, SAATH WATAN SE AAYI THI LEKAR\nHAAYE MUQADDAR AAJ AKELI, SHAAM KO QAIDI BAN KE CHALI HAI
english translation text: BROTHERS, NEPHEWS AND SONS — SHE HAD BROUGHT THEM ALL WITH HER FROM THE HOMELAND\nALAS, WHAT FATE — TODAY, ALL ALONE, SHE LEAVES FOR SHAAM AS A PRISONER

arabic text: PYAARI NABI KI, PYAARI NAWAASI\nSHAAM KO QAIDI BAN KE CHALI HAI
english translation text: THE BELOVED OF THE PROPHET (SAW), HIS CHERISHED GRANDDAUGHTER\nLEAVES FOR SHAAM AS A PRISONER

arabic text: BETON KO SADQA BHAAI PE KARKE, JISNE KIYE THE SHUKR KE SAJDE\nCHHOR KE TANHA LAASH KO USKI, SHAAM KO QAIDI BAN KE CHALI HAI
english translation text: SHE WHO OFFERED HER OWN SONS IN SACRIFICE FOR HER BROTHER, AND PROSTRATED IN GRATITUDE\nLEAVING HIS BLESSED BODY ALL ALONE, SHE LEAVES FOR SHAAM AS A PRISONER

arabic text: PYAARI NABI KI, PYAARI NAWAASI\nSHAAM KO QAIDI BAN KE CHALI HAI
english translation text: THE BELOVED OF THE PROPHET (SAW), HIS CHERISHED GRANDDAUGHTER\nLEAVES FOR SHAAM AS A PRISONER

arabic text: JISKI KANEEZEIN NIKLE NA BAAHAR, BALWE MEIN LAAYE USKO SITAMGAR\nHAAYE YE GHURBAT BINTE ALI KI, SHAAM KO QAIDI BAN KE CHALI HAI
english translation text: SHE WHOSE MAIDSERVANTS NEVER STEPPED OUTSIDE — THE OPPRESSORS DRAGGED HER INTO THE MOB\nALAS, THE DESTITUTION OF THE DAUGHTER OF ALI (AS) — SHE LEAVES FOR SHAAM AS A PRISONER

arabic text: PYAARI NABI KI, PYAARI NAWAASI\nSHAAM KO QAIDI BAN KE CHALI HAI
english translation text: THE BELOVED OF THE PROPHET (SAW), HIS CHERISHED GRANDDAUGHTER\nLEAVES FOR SHAAM AS A PRISONER

arabic text: KITNE HI QAIDI JISNE CHURAYE, AAJ WOH BIBI SAR KO JHUKAAYE\nEIK RIDA KI BAN KE SAWAALI, SHAAM KO QAIDI BAN KE CHALI HAI
english translation text: SHE WHO SET SO MANY PRISONERS FREE — TODAY THAT LADY BOWS HER HEAD\nBEGGING FOR JUST ONE VEIL, SHE LEAVES FOR SHAAM AS A PRISONER

arabic text: PYAARI NABI KI, PYAARI NAWAASI\nSHAAM KO QAIDI BAN KE CHALI HAI
english translation text: THE BELOVED OF THE PROPHET (SAW), HIS CHERISHED GRANDDAUGHTER\nLEAVES FOR SHAAM AS A PRISONER

arabic text: SOCHO WOH MANZAR 'SARWAR-O-REHAN', BHAAI HO JISKA WAARIS-E-QURAN\nKAISE WOH BIBI ASHK BAHAATI, SHAAM KO QAIDI BAN KE CHALI HAI
english translation text: PONDER THAT SCENE, 'SARWAR-O-REHAN' — SHE WHOSE BROTHER IS THE HEIR OF THE QURAN\nHOW THAT LADY SHEDS HER TEARS — SHE LEAVES FOR SHAAM AS A PRISONER

arabic text: PYAARI NABI KI, PYAARI NAWAASI\nSHAAM KO QAIDI BAN KE CHALI HAI
english translation text: THE BELOVED OF THE PROPHET (SAW), HIS CHERISHED GRANDDAUGHTER\nLEAVES FOR SHAAM AS A PRISONER
